drawing_shortcut_guide.canvas: While drawing, press W for a whiteboard or K for a blackboard. Choose another canvas state to return. W and K are not global shortcuts and do not require Control.
drawing_shortcut_guide.colors: Press R / G / B / Y / O / P to switch the pen to red, green, blue, yellow, orange, or pink. White and black have no default shortcuts; choose them from the color controls.
drawing_shortcut_guide.text: While drawing, press T to start left-aligned text or Shift+T for right-aligned text. Clicking a new position commits the current text and starts another. Press Esc to finish editing. Use the scroll wheel or Command++ / Command+- to change the font size. Arrow keys, Delete, selection, and paste are handled by the macOS text system.
hotkey_fallback.permission.message:
macOS reserves some Control+number shortcuts. DoraZoom needs permission to monitor keyboard input so it can use fallback shortcuts that match ZoomIt.

If DoraZoom is already enabled in System Settings but the shortcuts still do not work, quit and reopen DoraZoom. You will not be asked again during this session.
hotkey_fallback.permission.title: Enable DoraZoom Shortcuts
launch_at_login.unavailable: Launch at login requires running DoraZoom from DoraZoom.app.
permission_center.explanation: DoraZoom requests access only when you use the related feature. This page refreshes automatically when you return to DoraZoom.
permission_center.purpose.input_listenin: Used to show clicks and shortcuts in recordings, or listen for fallback hotkeys
permission_center.purpose.input_posting: Used to convert ⌃V after a screenshot to native ⌘V
permission_center.purpose.screen_capture: Used for zoom, drawing, screenshots, and screen recording
permission_center.title: Permissions
screen_recording_permission.message:
Zoom, drawing, screenshots, screen recording, and panorama capture require macOS to let DoraZoom read screen content.

After you grant access, macOS may ask DoraZoom to quit. DoraZoom will reopen automatically. Then try Control+1, Control+2, or Control+6 again.
screen_recording_permission.title: DoraZoom Needs Screen Recording Access
